items.alt_text: A lone figure stands before a tall blue patterned gate as sunlight casts long geometric shadows across a stone hall.
An elevated night view of buses and blurred vehicles moving through a lit transit station bordered by trees.
A rider on a rearing white horse rises above a herd of brown horses on a wide plain beneath hazy mountains.
Two silhouetted figures walk toward daylight at the end of a rough stone passage.
A long weathered concrete barrier with faded graffiti divides a pale sky from a dark foreground.
A shirtless man opens a refrigerator covered in colorful magnets in a domestic kitchen.
A turquoise mountain lake is bordered by evergreen forest and a jagged, snow-dusted mountain range.
A vertical aerial view shows dense homes meeting an abrupt, unbroken edge of green forest.
Black-and-white industrial buildings sit beneath a cloudy sky, with the words NOW IS OUR TIME painted on a wall.
A bare torso emerges from folds of black fabric against a nearly black background.
A man wearing sunglasses reclines nude on an ornate gold chair in a dark room while holding a phone.
A person stands framed by successive arched doorways inside a heavily damaged building.
Black keyboard keys spell NO WHERE TO ESC on a white surface beside a small insect.
The camera looks upward through a dark, fluted circular structure toward a small opening of sky.
Two people lean from the windows of a weathered teal train; one wears a bright orange head covering.
A small white house with a red roof stands on a green hill at night above an illuminated gate under a starry sky.
